description: This Java class 'BenchTestPane' creates a GUI panel with various vehicle component tests (e.g., fan, fuel pump, spark, injector, MIL, idle, dizzy) and buttons for sequences and research, integrating with other UI components and command controls.

classes.name: BenchTestPane
classes.description: A Swing panel providing vehicle component tests and control buttons.

methods.name: BenchTestPane
methods.description: Constructor initializing the panel with various test components and buttons.

methods.name: createMILTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for MIL (Check Engine Light) test.

methods.name: createIdleTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for Idle Valve test.

methods.name: createDizzyTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for Dizzy (distributor) test.

methods.name: createFanTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for Radiator Fan test.

methods.name: createFuelPumpTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for Fuel Pump test.

methods.name: createSparkTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for Spark plug test with selectable index.

methods.name: createInjectorTest
methods.description: Creates a panel for Injector test with selectable index.

methods.name: createIndexCombo
methods.description: Creates a combo box with indices 1 to 12 for selecting injectors or spark plugs.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing all test components.
